bundle_daily_report_desc: Daily activity reports with a draft → submitted → validated workflow.
daily_report_confirm_send_mail: Send this report by email to configured recipients?
daily_report_confirm_validate: Validate this report and generate the PDF?
daily_report_empty: No daily reports found for this store.
daily_report_empty_global: No daily reports match the selected filters.
daily_report_error_past_date: Cannot create a report for a past date.
daily_report_form_hint: Enter the daily totals for the 4 key indicators.
daily_report_mail_sent_error: Failed to send mail. Check the mail configuration and server logs.
daily_report_mode_per_day: Per day (each report = one day only)
daily_report_no_recipients_warning: No recipient selected — mail sending is disabled. Tick employees in the settings.
daily_report_no_shifts: No shifts scheduled for this day.
daily_report_notes_placeholder: Information to share with the team…
daily_report_reminder_alert: Today's daily report has not been submitted yet. Please fill it in before closing time.
daily_report_setting_auto_send_hint: Automatically send the email when a report is validated.
daily_report_setting_columns_hint: Choose which columns to display in the next-day shifts preview.
daily_report_setting_auto_validate_time_: At this hour, the previous day's report is validated automatically if nobody validated it yet. Leave empty to turn it off. Needs the hourly "auto-validate" scheduled task.
daily_report_setting_reminder_time_hint: From this time, if today's report has not been created yet, a reminder appears on the list of reports.
daily_report_setting_no_report_time_hint: From this time the reminder stops and a day without a report appears as "No report" in the list.
daily_report_setting_enabled_hint: Enable daily reports for this store
daily_report_setting_permissions_hint: Who can create, submit, validate, or delete this store's reports is now configured per role, in:
daily_report_setting_recipients_hint: Tick the store employees who receive the report. Each one gets their own e-mail, in their language, with the PDF attached when available.
daily_report_setting_legacy_recipients_h: These addresses are not linked to an account of the store. Untick one to remove it; none can be added any more, pick employees instead.
daily_report_error_recipients_unknown: This employee is not part of the store.
daily_report_error_access_denied: Access denied to this daily report.
daily_report_error_not_authorized_create: You are not authorized to create a report for this store.
daily_report_error_not_authorized_delete: You are not authorized to delete this report.
daily_report_error_not_authorized_send: You are not authorized to send this report.
daily_report_error_not_authorized_valida: You are not authorized to validate this report.
daily_report_error_permission_insufficie: Insufficient permission for this action on this report.
daily_report_error_report_locked: This report can no longer be modified.
daily_report_feature_daily_reports_desc: Access daily activity reports and summaries.
notif_daily_report_submitted_body: A daily report from :date (:store) is awaiting your validation.
notif_daily_report_validated_body: Your daily report from :date (:store) has been validated.
